document.abstract: The development of the stainless steels is related with the important position they have assumed in chemical and other industries because of corrosion resistance and unique properties. The steels suitable for use in motion picture industries are classified into two groups: steels for structural purposes, and steels for resistance to corrosion. A brief description of these steels and their possible applications in the industry are given.
